posts.image_text: A brand is how other people see where you are going.
posts.title: A brand is how other people see where you are going.

captions.instagram_facebook:
A brand is how other people see where you are going.

Most leaders can describe the destination for an hour. A customer gives you three seconds. Think of Volvo: few people can name a single model, yet almost everyone knows what it stands for. That is a vision other people can see.

posts.image_text: People remember how you made them feel, not your logo.
posts.title: People remember how you made them feel, not your logo.

captions.instagram_facebook:
People remember how you made them feel, not your logo.

Picture two cafés with nearly identical logos. One remembers your order; the other forgets your name. Same mark, different brands. Design can make a reputation recognisable. It cannot make it deserved.

posts.image_text:
Turn your vision into one sentence.
Write where you want the company to be in ten years.
Cross out every word a competitor could also say.
What is left is the start of your brand.
posts.title: Turn your vision into one sentence.

captions.instagram_facebook:
Turn your vision into one sentence.

1. Write where you want the company to be in ten years.
2. Cross out every word a competitor could also say.
3. What is left is the start of your brand.

Example: "the most trusted, innovative, customer-focused bank" becomes "the bank that explains everything in plain words." The first could belong to anyone. The second is a decision. Keep your sentence where you will see it each morning. We will build on it all month.
